d: Lucy talks to a developer with ambitious plans for a three bed semi in Croydon, Martin looks round another semi in Derbys Alvaston and Dion follows progress of a house damaged by the 2015 Cumbrian floods as it's restored to its former glory.

A trio of three bedroom properties make for two forever homes and an investment flat in todays show. Dion follows progress on a mum of twos dreams of transforming a Victorian house in Newcastle under Lyme into a wonderful family home.

Two cottages and a terraced house sold under the hammer are renovated by investors wanting to create homes and make some money. Lucy looks round a cottage in Upstreet near Canterbury while Dion checks out a terrace near Birmingham.

Three properties full of cracks are transformed into cracking homes after they are sold at auction. Martin looks round a former register office in Ilkeston, Lucy is in a basement flat in Shepherds Bush and Dion visits a project in Telford.

A small flat in Tooting in London, a former care home near a large park in Liverpool and a fire damaged house in Shropshire are all sold under the hammer. Martin, Lucy and Dion meet the new owners to hear their plans for their investments.

A cottage in Bigrigg in Cumbria with views and a busy road, a pretty attached cottage in Church Gresley in Derbyshire and a two bedroom flat in Londons Hammersmith with a big price tag are all sold under the hammer.
A holiday flat with a sea view in Seaton in Devon, a three bed 1930s semi in Crewe in Cheshire and a two bedroom flat in a period property in Londons South Norwood are all sold under the hammer.
